# Saturn Rings Reconstruction Lab

A MIT PRIMES research project portfolio exploring Saturn ring reconstruction through public Cassini RSS radio-occultation data, optical-depth visualization, inverse problems, stationary phase, branch bookkeeping, and numerical diagnostics.

Main pages:
- Homepage: https://primes-ring-website-p9yv.vercel.app/
- Mission Background: https://primes-ring-website-p9yv.vercel.app/background
- Data Hub: https://primes-ring-website-p9yv.vercel.app/data-hub
- Data Viewer: https://primes-ring-website-p9yv.vercel.app/viewer
- Mathematics: https://primes-ring-website-p9yv.vercel.app/math
- Results and Diagnostics: https://primes-ring-website-p9yv.vercel.app/overview
- Progress: https://primes-ring-website-p9yv.vercel.app/progress

Data sources:
Public NASA Planetary Data System Cassini RSS ring-occultation products.
